run_parallelized_gif_generation: run the script to generate a GIF from a trajectory file using parallel POV-Ray rendering
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms to render a single frame POV-Ray image from an ASE atoms object
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelize_generation to create POV-Ray images and compile them into a GIF from a trajectory file
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with traj-path, out-path, and num-workers arguments
review_pov_from_atoms: review pov_from_atoms to understand how it separates organic adsorbates from surface atoms for rendering
